title: Third declension: first entry
subtitle: Learn to find the stem beyond the nominative form.
overview: Third-declension nominatives often hide the stem. The genitive supplies a dependable clue: χάρις, χάριτος.
Do not try to predict every third-declension form from one ending; learn the lexical pair.

sections.title: χάρις and its stem
rows: of grace — genitive singular; stem χαριτ-
to, by, in grace — dative singular
